text: /* @component: .custom-swiper-indicator-numbers */ (function() { function initIndicatorNumbersSwiper() { const container = document.querySelector('.custom-swiper-indicator-numbers'); if (!container) return; new Swiper('.custom-swiper-indicator-numbers', { slidesPerView: 1, spaceBetween: 20, loop: false, navigation: { nextEl: '.swiper-button-numbers-next', prevEl: '.swiper-button-numbers-prev' }, pagination: { el: '.swiper-indicator-numbers-pagination', clickable: true, bulletClass: 'custom-bullet', bulletActiveClass: 'is-active', renderBullet: function (index, className) { return '' + (index + 1) + ''; } } }); } if (!document.getElementById('swiper-css')) { const link = document.createElement('link'); link.id = 'swiper-css'; link.rel = 'stylesheet'; link.href = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@11/swiper-bundle.min.css'; document.head.appendChild(link); } if (typeof Swiper !== 'undefined') { initIndicatorNumbersSwiper(); } else { let script = document.getElementById('swiper-js'); if (!script) { script = document.createElement('script'); script.id = 'swiper-js'; script.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@11/swiper-bundle.min.js'; document.head.appendChild(script); } script.addEventListener('load', initIndicatorNumbersSwiper); } })();

display: flex; flex-direction: row; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 16px; .custom-bullet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-white); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--slate-500) 30%, transparent); transition: all 0.2s ease; &.is-active { color: #ffffff; background: var(--teal-500); font-weight: bold; } &:hover:not(.is-active) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--slate-500) 50%, transparent); } }
